decision.observation: 9:00 pm; farmer on grass beside a dirt path that runs from bottom-left up toward the top-left; a fenced yard with a house roof below-right and a small dark structure at bottom-center. Path's continuation toward town lies down-left.
decision.hypothesis: Following the dirt path south-west (down-left) should bring me back to the town streets and plaza, from which the west road leads to the farm.
decision.memory: Greeted ~10/28; 405g; ~5 h until pass-out. Farm route: plaza → west road → bus stop corridor → farm north gap → farmhouse door. Stop exploring; go home.
